using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Hosting.Tests;

public class AdoNetGrainDirectoryServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddAdoNetGrainDirectory_CallsGetRequiredService_WhenAddingTransientValidator()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockOptionsMonitor = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions>>();
        var name = "test";
        bool getRequiredServiceCalled = false;

        // Setup mock to return options that pass validation
        var options = new AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions
        {
            Invariant = "SqlServer",
            ConnectionString = "Server=localhost;Database=test;"
        };
        mockOptionsMonitor.Setup(m => m.Get(name)).Returns(options);

        // Act
        services.AddSingleton<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions>>(mockOptionsMonitor.Object);
        var configureOptions = new Action<OptionsBuilder<AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions>>(b => { });
        
        var result = AdoNetGrainDirectoryServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAdoNetGrainDirectory(services, name, configureOptions);

        // Assert - Verify GetRequiredService was called by exercising the factory
        using var serviceProvider = result.BuildServiceProvider();
        var validator = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IConfigurationValidator>();
        Assert.NotNull(validator);
        
        // Verify the validator was constructed with expected parameters
        mockOptionsMonitor.Verify(m => m.Get(name), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAdoNetGrainDirectory_ValidatorReceivesCorrectOptionsByName()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var name = "test-directory";
        var expectedOptions = new AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions
        {
            Invariant = "Npgsql",
            ConnectionString = "Host=localhost;Database=testdb;"
        };

        // Act
        var configureOptions = new Action<OptionsBuilder<AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions>>(b =>
        {
            b.Configure(o => 
            {
                o.Invariant = expectedOptions.Invariant;
                o.ConnectionString = expectedOptions.ConnectionString;
            });
        });
        
        var result = AdoNetGrainDirectoryServiceCollectionExtensions.AddAdoNetGrainDirectory(services, name, configureOptions);

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = result.BuildServiceProvider();
        var validator = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IConfigurationValidator>();
        Assert.NotNull(validator);
        
        // The validator construction implicitly calls GetRequiredService and Get(name)
        // If this passes without exception, GetRequiredService worked correctly
    }
}
